status: questions and NEW proposals for review, not adopted

questions: Define an actual attunement procedure and finite item profile; do not borrow a standard external-game three-item cap without source/new-design declaration.
Pendant motive-certainty protection needs a precisely testable information scope; do not turn it into blanket divination immunity or a truth oracle.

Cancellation requires real caster and target agreement; define bearer action/range, what counts as one ongoing spell effect, multi-target/area/control/ongoing damage and absent/dead caster. It is not a universal Counterspell or resurrection. Retain actual beneficial Long Rest and item identity.
additionalInterfaces: Classify motive-certainty by actual promised output, not merely Divination school. Give at least two actual reviewed spell examples and one pending counterexample from the419/429 index; never promote pending text.

Define bearer/caster/target consent timing, multi-target cancellation unit, concentration and no refunds. Actual character communication is separate from player agreement. Item swap cannot reset charges.

questions: Supply full mundane spear profile, ownership/acquisition and Paladin/Soldier attunement gate. Finesse plus Heavy needs actual equipment-property rules and anatomy/size handling, not an imported external assumption.

Hesitation must be an actual finite timing/cost, not unlimited waiting or an opportunity to rewind a hit. Specify class versus character level, floor rounding, hit/miss, once-per-turn/attack restrictions and critical multiplication.
Do not grant Soldier an RP/divine engine or imply planar authority from radiant damage.
additionalInterfaces: Actual source Spear:1d6piercing,versatile1d8,Thrown20/60,3lb; relic overrides must be explicit. Soldier eligibility does not itself confer weapon proficiency. Finesse STR/DEX same ability attack/damage; Heavy Small disadvantage is an actual source interface.

Concrete proposed hesitation: spend Bonus Action before one actual spear attack on same turn; lose stored benefit at turn end, miss consumes it, no idle precharge. Define floor(characterLevel/2) vs class level openly, crit behavior and thrown/return/recovery. Alternative coherent finite cost is acceptable.

questions: Specify fear confession as character fiction, action/voice/touch and finite pending WIS-save benefit/expiry.
On the actual next save determine final outcome after legal rerolls, advantage cancellation and source immunity before shattering; one mirror cannot distribute endless independent benefits.
Reforming at Sentinel discretion needs a concrete finite scene/cost/time and no free refresh via repeated reconstruction; ownership/attunement remain distinct.
additionalInterfaces: Define a single pending mirror-linked beneficiary rather than unbounded gifting. Account for a WIS save made off-turn, successful reroll after initial failure, expiry, destruction away from user and another activation.
Finite Sentinel reformation must coexist with EPI07 one information boon per encounter without resetting either ledger. Do not equate reconstructed mirror with an automatically refreshed new item.

questions: Define glove physical profile, actual finite Matrix dust provenance and fabrication access. Naming dust is not a recovered way to mine the Equation, a known identity, an approved trade recipe or free stock.
Air-writing needs duration, range/visibility/volume/language, alteration/erasure and duplication rules. Glyph readability must not force beliefs or reveal who is secretly an ally/cultist.
Define fictional current advocacy of a peaceful passionless solution in a bounded scene; literacy does not grant protected comprehension, loyalty detection, KT/PT immunity or universal translation.
additionalInterfaces: Source created from dissolved Matrix dust is not a recovered crafting procedure. Provide one finite dust provenance and an explicitly NEW contained fictional fabrication recipe, or a finite already-crafted example, with real acquisition.

Determine each observer readability at observation time without using it as infallible allegiance/mind-reading. State whether copying is mundane ciphertext, translation requirements, line of sight and darkness.

questions: Twelve original scene seeds require executable geography, finite actors/stat blocks, exits, hazards, checks and fallback solutions. No new Courage skill: bind an actual ability/skill for the ladder.
Preserve original Wax Library source and jointly adopted Floor68 Melted Annex/Floor50 fallback; a general seed does not relocate that library or reset its finite destroyed books.
Toys, Silence Wraith and Echo Doppelganger need complete finite encounter profiles. Copy/release cannot circumvent existing forbidden copies, class prerequisites, resource limits or source identity.
Twin Wind timelines and Shardpool plane swap must use bounded explicitly NEW scene procedures with real clocks/return/party logistics, not promote pending Time Loop or planar spells.

Omega Theatre operates on character fiction and existing session-zero participation boundaries; no compulsion for players to disclose personal facts. Historical duel influence is a staged reenactment unless real chronology changes are expressly separately authored.
After Infinite Yield language is frame-dependent; portable use needs an explicit NEW staging wrapper, not an adopted campaign epoch.
additionalInterfaces: Supply ordinary exit and one noncombat path in each seed; fixed creature profiles cannot rely on the pending bestiary or vague scale-to-party instructions.

Resolve all travelers and full footprints for Shardpool, exact return deadline/equality and blocked origin; no trapping by omitted return machinery. Twin Wind merges no histories/resources and creates no second party.

Preserve finite scene identity on repeated visits. Rerolling d12 cannot refill relics, creatures, harvest sites or rewards. Quiet Well uses the exact current Living/Cracked distinction without adding a permanent boon exploit.

questions: Define actual Null-field boundaries and hourly exposure accumulation, partial hours, exiting/reentering, repeated saves, Null Veil duration and immunity. Separate Null Veil from Corrupted, Dissonance, expedition/serum Strain and KT/PT.
Passive Insight set5 must specify ordering versus modifiers and suppression; no hidden omniscience about motives.

All damage nonlethal is broader than the current melee-only knockout. Specify actual packet/DoT/minion/environment attribution and full damage/Wound/InstantDeath processing. Do not silently let nonlethal override fatalities or, conversely, allow repeated fatal damage while promising harmlessness.
BonusAction CHA15 shrug: exact success one-round suppression, failed Incapacitated endpoint, reattempt access while Incapacitated, concentration ending and independent exposure during suppression.

Mask confession and Archon blessing cleansing must name exact operative EPI04/EPI06 procedures after their review; mask fear advantage alone does not imply Null immunity. Define purge vs continuing field exposure and one-dose bittersap treatment.
additionalInterfaces: Define exactly when Null conversion is evaluated (damage-source owner at creation or resolution, current veil suppression, delayed packets), what counts as damage the character deals, and whether companion/environmental consequences count. Preserve a single root/recipient lineage and no duplicated prevention/resource triggers.

Choose and justify NEW explicit nonlethal integration for creature recipients, objects/constructs, positive-to-zero, already-zero and massive damage. If this source-specific rule prevents death/Wounds, identify the precise overridden stages; if it does not, explain why all damage non-lethal still admits fatal results. Do not hide the choice behind the generic word nonlethal.

Specify whether the one-round successful CHA shrug temporarily suppresses or actually removes the Veil, what remains during suppression, exact resume/expiry marker, and duration of failed-save Incapacitated. Failure cannot indefinitely prevent the Bonus Action needed to escape without a printed recovery procedure.

Keep original hourly WIS DC15 exposure, but define cumulative exposure/reentry, field identity, changing boundaries, repeat saves while already Veiled, unconscious/sleeping travelers and simultaneous exposures. A mask fear/Null-lullaby advantage does not automatically label every residual Null save a lullaby.

Specify each exact purge route: mask confession action/time/understood fictional content/wearing status, which Archon blessing/Guidance/Test counts, and finite brew dose/administration/consumption. Do not assume any previously granted temporary Archon card permanently grants purge.

Use numerical examples for HP10/max20 taking40, HP3/max20 taking8, a preexisting3-Wound failed save, a Stable0 victim hit again, ranged/area/delayed/shared damage, ongoing source whose Veil changed, a constructed target and direct HP cost. Keep death/Hunt decisions separate.

questions: Four named flora need finite habitats, actual recognition/harvest tools/check/DC/yield/time, replenishment and spoilage; Nature recognition alone does not spawn usable inventory.

Two parts bittersap plus one part echo lily and Bastion flame water need game-unit quantities, boiling apparatus/time, dose yield, costs/quality/failure and administration. No real-world botanical identification or synthesis is needed.

A new scoped antidote procedure does not silently alter the687 reviewed recipe catalog or grant generic poison/corruption/KT/PT cleansing. Tranquil thorn and Black hush moss have no effect merely because named.
Tie access to actual bounded sites or deliberate campaign provision; a plane chosen at character creation does not create harvested stock or free travel.
additionalInterfaces: Define units, weight, freshness/storage, stock and one-dose output. Nature identification is separate from harvest work; poison lore and actual tools matter only if current rules grant them.

Show a fully timed procurement-to-dose example plus exhausted stock, failed harvest, failed brewing, unwilling/unconscious patient and remaining exposure after purge. New harmless Tranquilthorn/Blackhush uses are allowed if explicitly authored; names alone confer no effects.

Provide an actual finite source of Bastion flame water accessible by the stated local scene sequence; home affiliation and the four finite Concord alcoves do not automatically create water stock or an onward route.
